problem_statement.value: Make a medical shunt valve which prevents blockage

desired_outcome.basis: outcome-verb phrase found verbatim in the user's message

observed_failure.basis: failure noun phrase found verbatim in the user's message

value: Solution must address the stated objective without introducing a larger failure mode
constraints.basis: default engineering constraint applied when the user stated none (the engine's standing problem contract)

context.basis: deterministic surface features of the message

domain_hypothesis.basis: keyword score 1 (hits: valve); full ranking recorded in domain_scores

physical_system.basis: system noun phrase matched in the user's message

target_variable.basis: quantity word matched in the message (outcome-object phrases included as fallback candidates)

assumptions.assumption: the message describes ONE engineering problem
assumptions.falsified_by: a second unrelated objective in the text

assumptions.assumption: the identified target variable is the quantity the user wants changed

success_condition.value: prevents blockage relative to the un-invented baseline, without violating the stated constraints
success_condition.basis: composed from the stated outcome and the identified target variable

failure_condition.value: the mechanism does not materially change the target variable, introduces a larger failure mode, or is contradicted by admissible evidence
failure_condition.basis: the engine's standing falsification contract (Art. XX/LII)
